card.name: Preservative-free statements and decimal points
card.fires_on: The word right after "contains" or "does not contain" in preservative statements ("no", "contain"). Also the decimal point or leading zero inside strengths such as 3.9 mg or 0.5/35.

modes.label: No preservative
modes.description: "no" or "contain" in statements that a product has no preservatives.

modes.label: Decimal in strengths
modes.description: The decimal point or a leading 0 inside a dose or product strength number.
modes.example: Buprenorphine transdermal system doses of 7<<.>>5 mcg/hour, 1

card.writes: It pushes toward words that continue a content description (e.g. "含", "入口") and away from "can"-type verbs.
card.plain: It fires on the word after "contains" in "contains no preservative" and on the decimal point in strengths like 0.5 or 7.5.
